topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can’t believe this! How could that teddy end up at some yard sale, like it was just another forgotten thing? Do you know how many nights I cried myself to sleep with that bear? It was my lifeline, my only friend when things got rough. Now it’s sitting there, probably dusty and overlooked, while some stranger haggles over pennies. This is all wrong. I should have been the one to find it, to bring it back home where it belongs. I’m going back to that sale, and I’m not leaving without my bear, no matter what it takes.
